notes.title: Voidside: Remix 2.0 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]The final act wasn't that 'final' after all.[/h2]

[b]It's my birthday![/b] Weird thing to start with I know, but because of that I wanted to give back to all of you lovely Voidside players with another update: Remix 2.0

Watch the trailer here [EPILEPSY WARNING]:
[previewyoutube=-CBXI6HGS8o;full][/previewyoutube] 

This update adds:

[h3]New Maps![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337300/b369baf0dc4f43764ed41fcf1d1e8b0d265e9822.png[/img]
2 New Remix maps have been added to Survival mode, with specific conditions that must be met to access them. Both of these maps hide secrets for you to find, tying into the other part of this update...

[h3]New Achievements![/h3]
5 New Achievements have been added to Voidside! These are harder achievements than usual, and are marked with a [b]green border[/b] to signify themselves. Two of these achievements require you to explore the new maps and find certain objects hidden within them, while other achievements require an INSANE amount of skill, such as completing THE ENTIRE CAMPAIGN on ultra nightmare. Good luck!

[h3]What next?[/h3]
Development is still on track for my next game, The Victor Initiative, which is getting an updated demo February next year! Voidside will be receiving an accessibility update sometime next year too.

That's all from me for this update, have fun!
Spacepiano :D

[h3]Full Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new map: Remix: Analysis.
[*] Added new map: Remix: Stasis.
[*] Added 5 new achievements which can be found in the Steam or Client achievements menu.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the client achievements menu showed different achievements to the steam achievements menu.
[*] Fixed a few small gameplay and menu bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Voidside: The Final Act is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Trailer[/h1]
[previewyoutube=6JbpoH9NPLk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About[/h2]
[h3]6 New Levels![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337300/ba01b0b00b4e8b160353311f8434133364320211.png[/img]
Voidside: The Final Act adds 6 new levels to the game, with 5 of those being available in survival mode. These levels introduce new game mechanics, tell a story both obvious and environmental, and are probably my favourite levels out of all the levels that I've made for this game.

[h3]Revamped Menus![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337300/7c67a4b752ed09c663e430831304b7c8d0931859.png[/img]
Almost all of Voidside's menus have been revamped in order to provide a smoother experience for both new and returning players!

[h3]Multiclassing![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43337300/59ffe67c2fcc651366a4d299293c8effb4b7c183.png[/img]
The much-requested feature is finally here! You can mix and match primary and secondary abilities in order to create the perfect build!

[h3]Acrobatics![/h3]
When you're in the air, you can now perform back flips and front flips in order to reach even more enemies! You can do this by simply aiming further up or down while airborne.

[h3]Optimisation & Graphics Settings![/h3]
The game has been optimised across the board, and it should now perform better no matter what graphics setting you use! On the topic of graphics settings, the lower settings have been altered to allow them to run on lower-end devices, meaning that even more people can play Voidside!

[h3]Leaderboard Reset[/h3]
Once again, the Leaderboard has been reset, and the top3 players have been added to the hall of fame, which is now located in Voidside's credits (accessible from the 'extras' tab of the main menu).

Thanks so much for sticking with Voidside all this time, or if you're a new player, welcome! There's never been a better time to jump in.

As always, Have fun!
Spacepiano :D

notes.title: Voidside: Gaiden I is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=x4xLmMrx2us;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New maps, new enemies, new everything![/h1]
Voidside: Gaiden I is the game's biggest update yet. It adds a lot of things designed to change the feel of the game to something much more challenging (think Voidside 1.0) but with a tonne of gameplay improvements to help the game feel more rewarding and more fun to play on a moment-to-moment basis!

[h2]A new old map![/h2]
The original first map, construction, has been completely revamped to be more spacious, focused more on movement, and a great introduction to the game and the story. There are easter eggs everywhere referencing where the game has been, and what might happen next in Gaiden II.

[h2]Enemy Variants![/h2]
Every enemy now has a rare, powered-up variant. The footsoldiers now have an armoured variant with a much larger health pool, the drones now have a super fast volatile twin, and the mutants now have a faster, smaller (and weaker) little brother. These enemies really help add variety to combat scenarios, and provide some much-needed challenge.

[h2]An online leaderboard![/h2]
Voidside now has an online leaderboard! This leaderboard is global, so it stays the same across all maps. See if you can beat my high score! :P
[i]The online leaderboard is actively moderated and any offensive names will not be permitted. If someone achieves a suspiciously high score (e.g. in the millions or higher) I will try to contact the score owner to check their validity.[/i]

[h2]Balance changes![/h2]
You may notice quite a few things about the new update. With the new enemies, it is a lot more easy to die, and on the large maps there are now multiple spawn points to increase challenge. I think that this is a step in the right direction, but I will be listening out for community feedback on these changes.

[h3]And that's it![/h3]
If you've been playing since the start, thanks so much for sticking with the game and I hope that you really enjoy the update. If you're a new player, thanks for giving the game a go! This update is for both new and old fans alike. I think this marks a turning point in the trajectory of the game, and it's finally getting to where I want it to be.

I hope you enjoy the update!
- Spacepiano :D

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
- Reworked map: Singularity (Previously known as 'Construction')
- Added 3 new enemies:
   - Armoured Footsoldier
   - Volatile Drone
   - Mini Mutant
- Added online leaderboard
- Added multiple spawn points on large and medium maps
- Collectables move towards the player at a much greater speed
- Collectables despawn after 30 seconds
- Added 2 new achievements
- Added 'now playing' text for music tracks
- Updated score UI
- Decreased almost all shop prices
- Fixed a lot of bugs!

notes.title: Announcing Voidside's next update! ... Wait what??
notes.content:
You read that right. Voidside's getting an update! Only problem is: The game isn't out yet!

I wanted to make this announcement now as I want to set expectations for how Voidside is going to be handled post-launch. Voidside is NOT an early access game, the game as it is can be played over and over again and players will receive the intended experience.

However, that does not mean that the game will be abandoned on arrival. I plan on updating this game over the course of time, not regularly, but whenever I personally feel like there is something I could add to Voidside outside the game's current scope. This is my way of making sure that Voidside's release doesn't get delayed over and over again.

Now, I bet you're wondering: When will this update come out? What does it include? Should I hold off until the update comes out?

I currently do not know when the update will come out, as I do not want to pressure myself with any unneeded deadlines. I can't go into specifics about the update itself, but I can share the title: 'Monsters an Machine Guns'. And lastly, If you want to get the game this update will not significantly change core gameplay or delete progress, so hop in as soon as the game launches!

This update will be free to all Voidside players, past, present and future.

Until then I hope you're looking forward to Voidside's release on the 16th, and if you're reading this in the future then I hope that you're having fun!

Spacepiano ;D

notes.title: Welcome, Jam Winners!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

If you recently won the Outer Wilds: New Horizons mod jam (This contest & Voidside are not affiliated with Mobius Digital, Outer Wilds is an amazing game and I highly recommend you play it) then this is for you!

If not, I have more Voidside news coming soon, but for now this post probably isn't for you.

[h3]What you [b]need[/b] to know[/h3]

Voidside is still in closed beta (you're early, wooo!), meaning some aspects are unfinished, and there isn't a proper tutorial.

To play the game you need these pieces of info:
[list]
[*]Enemies drop health crystals, which, you guessed it, increase your health. Levelling up provides a larger health boost.
[*]Before playing, go to the 'store' tab in menu to choose your weapons. (Otherwise you won't be able to kill anything).
[/list]

That's about it! If you have any questions, feel free to ask below!

Have fun!
Spacepiano

notes.title: Closed Beta | Upcoming Balance Changes!
notes.content:
Hi to all who currently have access to the closed beta (and all future members too!)

I'd like to note down some upcoming balance changes, expected to be pushed today or tomorrow. Leave  your thoughts in the replies if you want to share your thoughts.

First off, with a (somewhat) heavy heart, I've made the decision to remove melee attacks from the game. They will only ever be ridiculously strong or ridiculously weak, and let's face it - neither of those are fun. (Don't worry, I will be adding a VERY powerful endgame weapon to the game soon.)

On a more positive note however, I'd like to announce that 3 weapons are getting buffed - the shotgun, the rifle, and the burst rifle. They have all been modified to provide a 1-hit kill, as long as your aim is steady. 

For the shotgun, this means that it fires 3 pellets, and each does 40 damage (the typical enemy has 100HP).

For the rifle, one shot now equals one kill, and the fire rate has been greatly increased!

And finally for the burst, each bullet now does 50 damage.

I'm still looking into more ways of balancing the game, such as altering run speed, enemy damage (& amount) and additional weapon tweaks. Something to remember is that this game takes inspiration from vampire survivors in the sense that massive hordes of enemies are displayed at a time. The out-of-game progression system is pretty solid right now, but I'm struggling to think of ways I could allow per-game progression to feel more satisfying without breaking the flow of the game. Again, tell me in the replies if you have any ideas.

Edit: The closed beta is currently only available to people I know and have given special access, I plan on widening this scope soon.

That's all for now, have a great day!
- Spacepiano
